sentences.en: Don't touch my spaghetti bridge! The glue is still hardening.
sentences.zh: 别碰我的意大利面桥！胶水还在固化。

sentences.en: I glued the last piece of my collage with success.
sentences.zh: 我成功地把拼贴画的最后一块粘上了。

sentences.en: Gluons glue quarks together to form particles such as protons.
sentences.zh: 胶子将夸克结合在一起形成质子等粒子。
